held_fixed: Existing mechanism signatures, penalty kernels/intervention flags, moments, noise/schedule laws, architecture, initialization/named streams and all task-owned conditions/gates/budgets. Only the globally coupled lr and prior_lr_mult vary against each ordinary failed parent.
prediction: Each configuration two_pole.mean_abs >=0.3 under all unchanged gate conditions; falsifier <0.3. All subsequent eligible tasks must be measured under the same complete candidate.
selection_rule: Complete candidates and cohorts stay separate. A failed repair remains an alternative; a complete Tier1 PASS is necessary before any new configured family standard. Historical incomplete incumbents are not configured standards.
stop_rule: Ordinary first required failure stops remaining work in the tier and higher tiers. No per-task recipe, prior-only first-gate twins, repeated unchanged candidate, seed study, technique/objective/architecture addition, gate weakening or automatic extra search.
